_description: Performance budgets for the reading view (ODE-64). No editor interactions — input/paste metrics are not applicable. Budgets derived from the editor baseline with headroom for simpler read-only interactions.

evaluation.approval_rule: A trace is approved when every required metric is pass or warn and no required metric is fail.
evaluation.rejection_rule: A trace is rejected when at least one required metric is fail or a required metric is missing.

input_p95.note: Reading view has no text input — metric will not be present in reading traces.

paste_max.note: Reading view has no paste target — metric will not be present in reading traces.
